race.description: Murray Bridge Gold Cup - Book Now! Mdn Plate
race.comment: LARRY CAN (2) has been given plenty of time to mature, and he looked good when winning the most recent of 2 public trials. Cam Rawiller picks up the ride, and with some luck from a wide gate, he can make an immediate impact. Check the markets. VETTURA (11) won the first of her 2 public trials, and she also makes her debut from a wide gate. She might be wanting more ground but should pick up a win at short notice. UPSANDDOWNS (8) is another on debut, and this gelding hails from the in-form Stephen Theodore stable. He has the blinkers on, and with some solid trial efforts under his belt, he will be ready to rumble. ASTERNAL LOVE (9) makes her debut after winning 4 of her 5 trials, including 2 last month. A good draw will ensure that she is hard to beat. SIMPLY MAC (3) set the pace and fought hard for third on debut here 5 weeks ago, and though he has some maturing to do yet, he can figure in the top 3 again.
